DevopsProjectPipeline.name: DevopsProjectPipeline
DevopsProjectPipeline.description: Represents an association between a DevOps Center project and a release pipeline. In DevOps Center, each project is associated with a pipeline to define the sequence of stages work items move through, from initial development to final release. This association is typically established during the pipeline setup.

DevopsPipelineId.description: The ID of the associated DevopsPipeline record.

DevopsProjectId.description: The ID of the parent DevopsProject record.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: A unique identifier for the project-pipeline association.
